answer: The ridge index is deterministic from ledger replay, and hence nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1349 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the river. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the whisper queue while genuine members promoted earlier goes on earning. Each impostor pays 14 dollars up front. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
